profile.legalName: Regents of the University of California
profile.summary: The Regents of the University of California is the public board that governs the University of California system. Under the California Constitution it has full powers of organization and governance of the university. The Los Angeles campus (UCLA) is a public research university.

review.notes: The agenda names The Regents of the University of California (Los Angeles campus) in Los Angeles, and the cited Regents and UCLA pages confirm the legal name, constitutional governance role, public research university status, main phone (310) 825-4321, website and Los Angeles location. The summary is neutral and supported, and only campus-wide business contact details are given.
